requests.graphql: query HostedWorkers24h($accountTag: String!, $start: Time!, $end: Time!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { workersInvocationsAdaptive(limit: 1000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_leq: $end}) { sum { requests errors } quantiles { cpuTimeP50 cpuTimeP99 } } } } }
unit_notes: CPU fields are provider quantiles in milliseconds, not a summed CPU billing total

requests.graphql: query HostedR2Operations24h($accountTag: String!, $start: Time!, $end: Time!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { r2OperationsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_leq: $end}) { dimensions { actionType } sum { requests } } } } }
unit_notes: request counts by provider operation category
no bucket name is requested or emitted

requests.graphql: query HostedR2Storage24h($accountTag: String!, $start: Time!, $end: Time!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { r2StorageAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_leq: $end}, orderBy: [datetime_DESC]) { dimensions { bucketName datetime } max { objectCount uploadCount payloadSize metadataSize } } } } }
unit_notes: payload and metadata sizes are bytes as reported by R2 analytics
bucket identifiers are consumed in memory only and never emitted

requests.graphql: query HostedR2Bandwidth24h($accountTag: String!, $start: Time!, $end: Time!) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { r2BandwidthUsageAdaptiveGroups(limit: 1000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_lt: $end}, orderBy: [datetimeHour_ASC]) { sum { bytesUpload bytesDownload } dimensions { datetimeHour } } } } }
unit_notes: R2 bandwidth analytics exclude transfers smaller than 100 KiB
